evidence_quotes: Fosfaatrechtenvaststelling niet in strijd met artikel 1 van het EP.
Dat de vennoten van appellante hebben geïnvesteerd in mestbewerking en mestverwerking
rationale: This Dutch Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal (CBb) decision concerns the determination of agricultural phosphate rights (fosfaatrechtenvaststelling) for livestock farming and manure processing investments tested against Article 1 of Protocol No. 1 to the ECHR. Under the coding protocol, agricultural manure and phosphate quota disputes are explicitly excluded as NOT_WATER.
